text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's now.
I went alone to visit the shrine for hatsumode to pray for Air Shakur's success in the Senior class.
choice_data_list: (May she obtain what she desires.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having wrapped up some important business, I was on my way back to the academy while taking a light stroll, when—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey there.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, isn't that Air Shakur?
Even her casual clothes are flashy..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if her race record will be as flashy as
Opera O's this year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Annoying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she's grimacing, she's not overreacting like she did right after last year's Japan Cup.
It seems she's calmed down a bit.
choice_data_list: Were you out?
Were you out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, the real fight starts now.
choice_data_list: Where to?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I plead the fifth.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll understand if I follow along.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you ain't gonna pick a fight,
then do whatever the hell you want.
choice_data_list: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"We're heading into a crowd anyway.
One more person ain't gonna make it any more annoying."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, don't go pestering me with questions later.
Part of doing this is to save that hassle.
choice_data_list: So, what are you going to do?
So, what are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All sorts of things. Listening to talk about music or math, watching event races...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, don't pick all of them.
Stick to just one.
choice_data_list: Tag along to the music event
Tag along to the mathematics lecture.
Tagging Along to the New Year's Race Event

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't really mind, but
don't make a scene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where I went with Air Shakur was a casual outdoor festival. There were plenty of food stalls set up, creating a lively atmosphere.
choice_data_list: So you like this sort of thing too.
You like this sort of thing too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be here if I didn't have a reason.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes sound just forces its way into my head.
On the rare occasion it hits the spot, it's pretty damn good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What drifted in were mellow electronic tones.
A fleeting melody, as if melting into the sky...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew she often listened to hip-hop on a regular basis.
However, it turned out she listened to a much wider variety of genres than I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a day where I learned
just how broad Air Shakur's range of hobbies is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You serious?
You're not even interested, are ya?
choice_data_list: I think it sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
maybe that's just right for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Air Shakur brought me was a mathematics seminar aimed at middle and high school students.
It seems a famous mathematician is giving a lecture, but...
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little too easy for Air Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Today's mainly about listening to what that guy has to say.
Opportunities like this are pretty rare in Japan.
choice_data_list: Is she really that incredible?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They won a math award, and the research
they did for it is crazy interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I figured I could hear some interesting stories, whether it's about what happened back then or whatever else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems this is someone she respects deeply.
After that, the lecture began—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was fun.
Man, that person really is amazing.
choice_data_list: She was someone who spoke in plain, simple words, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's really dedicated to math education,
so I'm sure she's mindful about that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Completely opposite from the old man.
choice_data_list: So Air Shakur's father is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A mathematician.
A pure researcher through and through.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm going home.
I'm glad I came."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're seriously fine with racing even on your day off?
choice_data_list: Because I love racing.
Because I love racing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Better than having anyone else follow me, I suppose.
It's what always happens anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, as part of a New Year's special event race, young Umamusume held a special race and put on performances.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Number 1 has got great legs.
Number 2 could put up a real fight if she built up more stamina."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Number 3... It'd be better to rethink how she trains a bit. If it were me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur watches and evaluates the Umamusume children giving it their all.
Somehow... his eyes look like they're enjoying it.
choice_data_list: Does Air Shakur like kids?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Does it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't overthink it.
I don't particularly like it or hate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, running techniques evolve year after year.
Track conditions change, too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's important to see it
with your own eyes, right?"
choice_data_list: So Air Shakur is searching for her future right now, huh.
Air Shakur is searching for her future right now, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't say it like it's some cheesy cliché.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Look, it's about to start.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She headed out somewhere
to finish off the rest of her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely once all that is over,
she'll continue her preparations for the Senior year.
choice_data_list: (I'll do my best too.)
(I should do my best too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the New Year began
on an upbeat note—
